visualCharacteristics.video: Native HTML5 player (<video controls preload='none'>) with the poster image; MP4 from the site's media host (iprsoftwaremedia.com) plays directly
visualCharacteristics.default: YouTube/Vimeo lazy facade: poster with a circular play button; the youtube-nocookie / Vimeo (dnt) iframe is created on click, only with consent

contentPattern.structure: row 1: poster image (optional); row 2: link to the media (.mp4 for the video option, or a YouTube/Vimeo URL)
contentPattern.example: Embed (video): poster image, link to bridget cordova social cut v2.mp4
contentPattern.consent: Third-party iframes wait for the project consent check (scripts/consent-check.js, 'consent.update' event with detail.consented). Without consent a click shows a notice with a 'watch it on YouTube/Vimeo' link (new tab) instead of loading the iframe

notes: 3 blog-article stories start with an Embed (video) hero; the article-header moves it into the header

reuseGuidance: Use 'Embed (video)' with a poster image and an .mp4 link for self-hosted video. Use plain 'Embed' with a YouTube or Vimeo link (and optionally a poster image) for third-party video.
